column1: # Version codes :wear has already spent, oldest first.
# Its own ledger, separate from app/release-history.tsv: `verifyReleaseVersion` is registered per
# application module and reads `<module>/release-history.tsv`, and this module is its own artifact
# with its own version line even though it shares `:app`'s applicationId.
# "Spent" means the code has been attached to a release artifact that left this repository. Never
# edit or remove a line: a spent code stays spent forever. Tab-separated: version code, version
# name, date the code was spent, and what spent it.
# (MAJOR * 10000 + MINOR * 100 + PATCH) and for all four rules this file feeds. Empty of entries
# today: :wear has never shipped, so 100/0.1.0 in wear/build.gradle.kts is still unspent.
